research_rationale:
Executive Order 12597 of May 13, 1987 (52 FR 18335, Federal Register Vol. 52 No. 94, Friday May 15, 1987) establishes procedures for presidential review of Department of Transportation international aviation decisions under Section 801 of the Federal Aviation Act. The held original is the machine-extracted text of the govinfo Federal Register PDF (pages 18335-18337) with the title, preamble, Sections 1 to 12, the Federal Register document number 87-11317 and the White House dateline all present, so identity and completeness were confirmed against the text itself. The held U.S. Code release point 119-121 prints the order in full as a note to 49 U.S.C. 41307 (CURRENT:EO:12597#0); that is the current predicate for every clause. Searches: the Office of the Law Revision Counsel Code search, the eCFR search as of 2026-10-14 and the Federal Register catalogue disposition search were read for coverage notes before use. The only later-events hit for this order is the order revoking Executive Order 12547, which is its own section 1 and not a later event; no later order amends, revokes or supersedes Executive Order 12597 in the held sources. The order has no expiry, sunset or contingent end in its own text; the numbered day periods in sections 3 and 5 run per decision. The one gap noted is that the order names Executive Order 12356, which the packet holds only as actor context; no held source shows that fact ended any clause.
